title: Unit 12 Consolidation: Civic Resistance, Dissent & Legal Philosophy
goal: I can say what I will not give up, whatever happens (*Történjék bármi, …*).
I can give the ground of my stance (*lelkiismereti okból*, *meggyőződéstől vezérelve*).
I can tell legality from legitimacy, and report what a text says about antipolitics.
